🌍 Global Derivatives Fees & Commissions
Every derivatives trade creates multiple revenue streams across the financial ecosystem:
💰 Exchange Fees – CME, ICE, Cboe, Eurex, HKEX, JPX, SGX
 💰 Clearing Fees – LCH, CME Clearing, OCC and other CCPs
 💰 Broker Commissions – Execution, give-up and negotiated commissions
 💰 OTC Fees – Dealer spreads, structuring, clearing and bilateral charges
Across Equities, Interest Rates, FX, Commodities and Credit, these are the major fee/revenue beneficiaries of global derivatives activity.
📌 High-volume trading + clearing + brokerage = significant recurring fee revenue.
The real challenge for banks is ensuring every fee charged is accurate, reconciled and aligned with the applicable fee schedule.
Fee Reconciliation → Fee Intelligence → Cost Optimization
